title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode6 Vanishing Snow

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Looks like OWN uploaded a new song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So cold and sharp, but also brittle.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's just like Enanan said. It feels like whoever wrote it wants to be alone...like they don't need anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late? I gotta go...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can buy some flowers near the station. I should take a towel...some pajamas...and...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Oh, hello Kanade. Here for your weekly visit, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Here, I brought a change of clothes, a towel, and...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line:
Oh, such lovely flowers.
You're always so thoughtful, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Mr. Yoisaki. Kanade is here to see you.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line:
Oh, he was awake a few minutes ago.
He must have just nodded off.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: He started remembering a few more things yesterday. He even talked about you for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I just stopped by to drop off his things. I should get going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I didn't realize you could write such gentle songs. I'm sure your mother would have loved it, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
You have such a gift, Kanade.
You've really been blessed by music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, make sure you keep creating your own music.

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Of course! Time to get to work♪>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<K, I finished the illustration from yesterday.
Can you take a look?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Huh? You're right. She was here earlier this evening.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Maybe she fell asleep. Unlike us, she goes to school on a regular basis. I'm sure even she gets tired.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<She said she'd be back on later, though.
Oh well, I guess even Yuki can drift off sometimes.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<We can get started without her for now.
I'll send the file over, K.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay, thanks. Amia, would you send a progress report too?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <It's already been a week since we've heard from Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Did she mention anything about going on vacation?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I didn't hear anything. I'm starting to get worried.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Do you think something happened?
I just hope she didn't have an accident or get sick or something.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Amia, don't say stuff like that out loud. It's bad luck.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I felt like your song saved me.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Let's see if there's any other way of getting in touch with her.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yeah. I don't think we'll be able to stop worrying until we do.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But how do we do that? We don't know her name, what she looks like, or where she lives.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Hm... It's too bad she doesn't upload selfies like you. A little doxing of her face and room, and I bet we could figure out a location.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Could you not say such creepy things?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<If only we had some sort of clue.
Oh, maybe there's something in the chat logs that'll tell us more about her.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Hm... It doesn't look like it.
Yuki doesn't talk about herself very much.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <The only thing I know about her is that her mom seems like a meddler.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's nothing.
What about the shared folder? Anything in there that'll help? ...Huh?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<There's an audio file in here I've never seen.
It looks like it was added by Yuki and was last updated on the day she stopped showing up.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Maybe Yuki made it and just forgot to name it or something.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I feel like Yuki would have told us if she'd put anything in the shared folder, though. Should we listen to it and see what it is?>
